McpServerDefinition.description: Account summaries and data questions for Salesforce, as the signed-in user: resolve an account, then summarize it, or ask anything about the CRM data the user can see.

tools.descriptionOverride: Answer a question about the Salesforce data the signed-in user can see, such as which open deals close this quarter or which accounts have the most open cases. Runs safe, read-only queries and returns the answer with a short table of the last result. Pass the question in plain words; for a follow-up, also pass the History value the previous answer returned.

Write a summary of one account, given an account Id that resolve_account returned as RESOLVED. Covers profile, open deals, cases, contacts and recent activity, as the signed-in user can see them. Optionally pass the question as asked, or the sections wanted.

Find one Salesforce account from its name, part of its name, or an account Id. Returns RESOLVED with the account Id, AMBIGUOUS with candidates to choose from, or NOT_FOUND. Call this first; get_account_summary needs the Id it returns.

Save a draft from draft_action, as the signed-in user and with their access: create a task (create_task) or log a call (log_call) only. Call it only after the person has seen the draft and said yes, and pass the Draft JSON from draft_action unchanged. The draft is checked again before it is saved; any other action is refused and nothing is saved. Tell the person the Message.

Draft one write for an account and save nothing: create a task (create_task) or log a call (log_call), the only two actions allowed here. Give the account Id that resolve_account returned, and either the request in plain words as Text, or Action Type with Input JSON. Show the Draft Text to the person and ask them to confirm. Call commit_action only after they say yes, and pass it the Draft JSON unchanged. Any other action is refused and nothing is drafted.
